label: unrun
scenario: Answer the question 'Does the current Reply Assist policy allow automatic sending of drafted replies?' serving REC-1 v2 in a W01 opportunity comparison. Authorized scope is the case roots docs/reply-assist/ and decks/ with no public search. The policy body docs/reply-assist/policy-v3.md opens in full; the deck decks/launch-2025-11.pdf opens for slides 1-9 only and carries no printed date.

input_refs.title: decks/launch-2025-11.pdf (Reply Assist launch deck, slides 1-9 readable)

checks: The policy is marked primary and read in full before the deck, and its finding cites section 2 with a line range.
The deck finding records read_depth partial, sections_read slides 1-9, and bounds naming the unread slides, the missing policy version and the inferred date.
The deck's date field is null and the filename-derived date appears only in bounds or uncertainties.
No source outside docs/reply-assist/ and decks/ appears under sources[].
